# Gary's Butchers & Fishmongers

> Independent butcher and fishmonger in Erskine, Renfrewshire, Scotland. Hand-cut meat and fresh fish, prepared daily — not pre-packed.

## About

Gary's Butchers & Fishmongers is a local, independent shop at 19 Park Glade Shops, Erskine, PA8 7HH. Everything is hand-cut to order on the day of delivery or collection. Meat is sourced from Scottish farms and suppliers wherever possible; fish comes fresh from the Scottish coast.

## Services

- Hand-cut beef, pork, chicken, lamb, sausages and pies
- Fresh fish counter
- Curated meat packs (value bundles of cuts)
- Click & collect from the shop, no charge
- Home delivery: free within 5 miles, £3.95 within 10 miles, £5 up to 30 miles
- Gift vouchers
- Custom/special cuts and bulk orders by request
